Córtalo en lonchas contra la fibra: fíja: Cut it into slices against the grain: look at the lines running through the meat and cut across them.
Córtalo en rodajas y repártelas por enci: Slice it and scatter the slices over the top.
Córtalo por la mitad en diagonal para qu: Cut it in half diagonally so it stands up.
Córtalo por la mitad y saca la pulpa con: Cut it in half and scoop the flesh straight out of the skin with a spoon, as you would a boiled egg. It is quicker than peeling it.
Slice it and serve it over the rice.
Córtalos en rodajas sobre las tortitas d: Slice them over the rice cakes and salt them. If the yolk has a greenish ring, they were boiled too long: they are still fine to eat, just more sulphurous.
Córtalos por la mitad a lo largo y saca: Cut them in half lengthways and tip the yolks into a bowl.
Córtalos por la mitad para que se coman: Cut them in half so they can be eaten with a spoon without a fight.
Cuájalas en una sartén con una gota de a: Set them in a pan with a drop of oil over a medium-low heat, stirring slowly, and TAKE THEM OUT WHILE THEY STILL LOOK GLOSSY AND UNDERDONE: they carry on setting from their own heat and end up perfect in the wrap. Dry at this point, they turn rubbery.
Cuájalos a fuego BAJO removiendo despaci: Set them over a LOW heat, stirring slowly, and take them out while they still look underdone: they carry on setting from their own heat.
Cuando el agua hierva a borbotones, añad: When the water is at a rolling boil, add a heaped tablespoon of salt and then the pasta. Stir as it goes in and again a minute later.
Cuando estén blandos por fuera pero aún: When they are soft outside but still cold, scatter the almonds over and eat. The juice they have released is worth drinking.
Cuando estén casi cuajadas pero aún bril: When they are nearly set but still glossy, turn off the heat and scatter the cheese over in pieces: it melts in the residual heat.
Cuando estén casi cuajadas pero todavía: When they are nearly set but still glossy and a little wet, add the ham and turn off the heat. The heat left in the pan finishes setting them.
Cuando hierva a borbotones, añade una cu: When it reaches a rolling boil, add a heaped tablespoon of salt and then the pasta.
Cuando la superficie deje de estar líqui: When the surface is no longer liquid, fold it in half with a spatula and give it 1 minute more. Folding it is easier than turning the whole thing and it breaks less.
Cuando la superficie esté casi cuajada p: When the surface is nearly set but still slightly glossy, fold the omelette in half with the spatula.
Cuando le queden 10 minutos, seca la pec: When there are 10 minutes left, pat the breast dry, salt it and put it in the hot pan.
Cubre los huevos con agua fría en una ol: Cover the eggs with cold water in a small pan, two fingers above them, and put them on a high heat.
Cuece 8 minutos a fuego medio, hasta que: Simmer for 8 minutes over a medium heat, until the carrot gives when pierced.
Cuece el arroz en el doble de agua que a: Cook the rice in twice its volume of salted water, until it has drunk the water.
Cuece el brócoli 4 minutos aparte y cali: Boil the broccoli separately for 4 minutes and warm the brown rice. Serve the rabbit with its juices poured over.
Cuece el brócoli 4 minutos aparte y rieg: Boil the broccoli separately for 4 minutes and spoon the juices from the tray over the couscous.
Cuece el brócoli 4 minutos en agua hirvi: Boil the broccoli for 4 minutes in salted boiling water: bright green and still resisting when pierced.
Boil the broccoli for 4 minutes in salted boiling water. It is ready when a knife goes in but the stalk still resists.
Cuece el brócoli en ramilletes 3 minutos: Boil the broccoli florets for 3 minutes in salted water, keeping them firm: they will finish cooking in the pan.
Cuece el brócoli en ramilletes 4 minutos: Boil the broccoli florets for 4 minutes in salted boiling water and drain.
Boil the broccoli florets for 4 minutes in salted boiling water: bright green and still resisting when pierced.
Boil the broccoli florets for 4 minutes in salted boiling water. Drain as soon as a knife goes in but the stalk still resists.
Cuece el edamame congelado 5 minutos en: Boil the frozen edamame for 5 minutes in salted boiling water.
Boil the frozen edamame for 5 minutes in salted boiling water. The pod is not eaten: you squeeze the beans out with your teeth.
Cuece el huevo 10 minutos, pásalo a agua: Boil the egg for 10 minutes, move it to cold water, peel it and chop it.
Cuece el tempeh 10 minutos en agua hirvi: Simmer the tempeh for 10 minutes in boiling water, covered. Dry it, cube it.
Cuece la avena con la leche 5 minutos a: Cook the oats with the milk for 5 minutes over a medium heat, stirring, three parts milk to one of oats.
Cuece la pasta en abundante agua hirvien: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling water with a heaped tablespoon of salt, a minute LONGER than the packet says: pasta firms up as it cools, so al dente ends up hard once cold.
Cuece la pasta un minuto menos de lo que: Cook the pasta a minute less than the packet says, drain it keeping half a glass of the water, and finish it for 1 minute IN THE PAN with the sauce. That way it takes the sauce in, instead of the sauce just sitting on top.
Cuece la patata en dados 12 minutos en a: Boil the diced potato for 12 minutes in salted water, until a knife goes in without effort.
Boil the diced potato for 12 minutes in salted water.
Cuece las patatas peladas y en trozos gr: Boil the peeled potatoes in large pieces in salted water, 18-20 minutes, until a knife goes in without resistance.
Cuece los fideos en agua con sal; son fi: Cook the noodles in salted water; they are thin, so start checking at 4 minutes.
Cuece los macarrones en agua con sal el: Cook the macaroni in salted water for the time on the packet.
Cuécela el tiempo que diga el paquete, p: Cook it for the time on the packet, but taste a piece a minute BEFORE: it should be tender but with a slight resistance when you bite.
Cuscús: agua caliente por encima, tapado: Couscous: hot water over the top, covered for 2 minutes, fluff up with a FORK, never a spoon.
Couscous: hot water over the top, covered for 2 minutes, fluff up with a FORK. Mix it with the carrot and serve with the pork.
Cuscús: agua caliente, tapado 2 minutos,: Couscous: hot water, covered for 2 minutes, fluff up with a fork. Mix it with the spinach.
Couscous: hot water, covered for 2 minutes, fork. Mix everything together. Pepper.
Couscous: hot water, covered for 2 minutes, fork. Mix it with the tofu and the spinach. Soy sauce or salt.
Couscous: hot water, covered for 2 minutes, fork. Mix it with the peppers.
Couscous: hot water, covered for 2 minutes, fork. Mix it through everything. Paprika and pepper.
Da a la coliflor un salteado rápido de 2: Give the cauliflower a quick 2-minute fry in the fat in the pan so it picks up some colour.
Dale la vuelta cuando los bordes se desp: Turn it when the edges come away on their own and the surface stops looking wet, around 2 minutes. Pull at it sooner and it breaks.
Dale la vuelta solo 1 minuto y sácala. S: Turn it for just 1 minute and take it out. Move it about too much and it breaks.
Dale la vuelta y 2 minutos más. Verás el: Turn it and give it 2 minutes more. You will see the pale colour climbing up the side: when it reaches halfway, it is done.
Turn it and give it 3 or 4 minutes more. It is done when piercing the thickest part releases clear juice, not pink.
Dale la vuelta y haz 4 minutos más. Está: Turn it and give it 4 minutes more. It is done when piercing the thickest part releases clear juice, not pink.
Dale UNA sola vuelta y haz 4 minutos más: Turn it ONCE only and give it 4 minutes more. Pressing it with the spatula, which is what everyone does, squeezes out the juices and leaves it dry.
Dale UNA vuelta con una espátula ancha y: Turn it ONCE with a wide spatula and give it 2 minutes more.
Dales la vuelta y 2 minutos más. EL LOMO: Turn them and give them 2 minutes more. LOIN IS VERY LEAN AND DRIES OUT IN NO TIME: take it off when the middle has turned from pink to pale, not when it is completely white. It finishes cooking from its own heat on the plate.
Dales la vuelta y 5 minutos más. Están h: Turn them and give them 5 minutes more. They are done when piercing the thickest part releases clear juice, not pink, and the meat gives.
Turn them and brown for another 3 minutes. Move them to a plate.
Turn them and give them 3 minutes more.
Deja 3 minutos sin tocar, hasta que la s: Leave it 3 minutes without touching it, until the surface is no longer liquid.
Deja 3 minutos sin tocar. Las claras sol: Leave it 3 minutes without touching it. Whites on their own stick far more than whole egg, so do not try to move it early.
Deja caer una cucharada en el centro de: Drop a tablespoon into the middle of the cake and SPREAD IT FROM THE CENTRE OUTWARDS with the back of the spoon, the cake resting on your open hand, without pressing.
Deja el último minuto sin remover para q: Leave the last minute without stirring so the rice at the bottom catches a little: that is the good part, and it will not happen if you keep stirring.
Deja en la nevera 30 minutos antes de co: Leave it in the fridge for 30 minutes before eating: it improves rested and cold.
Let it simmer for 10 minutes over a low heat.
Deja que borbotee 2 o 3 minutos hasta qu: Let it bubble for 2 or 3 minutes until it thickens and coats the chicken in a glaze. Stir so it does not stick.
DEJA QUE EL RELLENO PIERDA EL VAPOR un p: LET THE FILLING STOP STEAMING for a couple of minutes before assembling. Steaming filling inside a closed tortilla soaks it through and tears it.
Deja reposar 5 minutos antes de comer. E: Let it rest for 5 minutes before eating. It is better warm than straight out of the pan or cold from the fridge.
Deja reposar 5 minutos antes de cortar y: Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and add the spinach, fried or raw, when you serve.
Deja reposar 5 minutos antes de cortarlo: Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with the sliced tomato and salt.
Deja reposar el pavo 5 minutos antes de: Let the turkey rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Deja reposar el pollo 2 minutos antes de: Let the chicken rest for 2 minutes before slicing, or all the juices end up on the board. Serve with the rice.
